lines.gurmukhi: ਜਰਾ ਜੀਵਨ ਜੋਬਨੁ ਗਇਆ ਕਿਛੁ ਕੀਆ ਨ ਨੀਕਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: jaraa jeevan joban gaiaa kichh keeaa na neekaa ||
lines.translation: Youth and old age - my entire life has passed, but I haven't done any good.

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਜੀਅਰਾ ਨਿਰਮੋਲਕੋ ਕਉਡੀ ਲਗਿ ਮੀਕਾ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: ihu jeearaa niramolako kaudee lag meekaa ||3||
lines.translation: This priceless soul has been treated as if if were worth no more than a shell. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਮੇਰੇ ਮਾਧਵਾ ਤੂ ਸਰਬ ਬਿਆਪੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: kahu kabeer mere maadhavaa too sarab biaapee ||
lines.translation: Says Kabeer, O my Lord, You are contained in all.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੁਮ ਸਮਸਰਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਮੋਹਿ ਸਮਸਰਿ ਪਾਪੀ ॥੪॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: tum samasar naahee daiaal mohi samasar paapee ||4||3||
lines.translation: There is none as merciful as You are, and none as sinful as I am. ||4||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: bilaaval ||
lines.translation: Bilaaval:

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਿਤ ਉਠਿ ਕੋਰੀ ਗਾਗਰਿ ਆਨੈ ਲੀਪਤ ਜੀਉ ਗਇਓ ॥
lines.transliteration: nit uth koree gaagar aanai leepat jeeu gaio ||
lines.translation: Every day, he rises early, and brings a fresh clay pot; he passes his life embellishing and glazing it.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਾਨਾ ਬਾਨਾ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਸੂਝੈ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਸਿ ਲਪਟਿਓ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: taanaa baanaa kachhoo na soojhai har har ras lapatio ||1||
lines.translation: He does not think at all of worldly weaving; he is absorbed in the subtle essence of the Lord, Har, Har. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਮਾਰੇ ਕੁਲ ਕਉਨੇ ਰਾਮੁ ਕਹਿਓ ॥
lines.transliteration: hamaare kul kaune raam kahio ||
lines.translation: Who in our family has ever chanted the Name of the Lord?

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਬ ਕੀ ਮਾਲਾ ਲਈ ਨਿਪੂਤੇ ਤਬ ਤੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਨ ਭਇਓ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: jab kee maalaa laee nipoote tab te sukh na bhaio ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Ever since this worthless son of mine began chanting with his mala, we have had no peace at all! ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੁਨਹੁ ਜਿਠਾਨੀ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਦਿਰਾਨੀ ਅਚਰਜੁ ਏਕੁ ਭਇਓ ॥
lines.transliteration: sunahu jithaanee sunahu diraanee acharaj ek bhaio ||
lines.translation: Listen, O my sisters-in-law, a wondrous thing has happened!

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਤ ਸੂਤ ਇਨਿ ਮੁਡੀਂਏ ਖੋਏ ਇਹੁ ਮੁਡੀਆ ਕਿਉ ਨ ਮੁਇਓ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: saat soot in mudee(n)e khoe ihu mudeeaa kiu na muio ||2||
lines.translation: This boy has ruined our weaving business. Why didn't he simply die? ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖਾ ਕਾ ਏਕੁ ਹਰਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸੋ ਗੁਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦਇਓ ॥
lines.transliteration: sarab sukhaa kaa ek har suaamee so gur naam daio ||
lines.translation: O mother, the One Lord, the Lord and Master, is the source of all peace. The Guru has blessed me with His Name.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਪ੍ਰਹਲਾਦ ਕੀ ਪੈਜ ਜਿਨਿ ਰਾਖੀ ਹਰਨਾਖਸੁ ਨਖ ਬਿਦਰਿਓ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: sa(n)t prahalaad kee paij jin raakhee haranaakhas nakh bidario ||3||
lines.translation: He preserved the honor of Prahlaad, and destroyed Harnaakhash with his nails. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਘਰ ਕੇ ਦੇਵ ਪਿਤਰ ਕੀ ਛੋਡੀ ਗੁਰ ਕੋ ਸਬਦੁ ਲਇਓ ॥
lines.transliteration: ghar ke dev pitar kee chhodee gur ko sabad laio ||
lines.translation: I have renounced the gods and ancestors of my house, for the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹਤ ਕਬੀਰੁ ਸਗਲ ਪਾਪ ਖੰਡਨੁ ਸੰਤਹ ਲੈ ਉਧਰਿਓ ॥੪॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: kahat kabeer sagal paap kha(n)dan sa(n)tah lai udhario ||4||4||
lines.translation: Says Kabeer, God is the Destroyer of all sins; He is the Saving Grace of His Saints. ||4||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: bilaaval ||
lines.translation: Bilaaval:

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੋਊ ਹਰਿ ਸਮਾਨਿ ਨਹੀ ਰਾਜਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: kooo har samaan nahee raajaa ||
lines.translation: There is no king equal to the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਏ ਭੂਪਤਿ ਸਭ ਦਿਵਸ ਚਾਰਿ ਕੇ ਝੂਠੇ ਕਰਤ ਦਿਵਾਜਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: e bhoopat sabh divas chaar ke jhoothe karat divaajaa ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: All these lords of the world last for only a few days, putting on their false displays. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੇਰੋ ਜਨੁ ਹੋਇ ਸੋਇ ਕਤ ਡੋਲੈ ਤੀਨਿ ਭਵਨ ਪਰ ਛਾਜਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: tero jan hoi soi kat dolai teen bhavan par chhaajaa ||
lines.translation: How can Your humble servant waver? You spread Your shadow over the three worlds.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਾਥੁ ਪਸਾਰਿ ਸਕੈ ਕੋ ਜਨ ਕਉ ਬੋਲਿ ਸਕੈ ਨ ਅੰਦਾਜਾ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: haath pasaar sakai ko jan kau bol sakai na a(n)daajaa ||1||
lines.translation: Who can raise his hand against Your humble servant? No one can describe the Lord's expanse. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਚੇਤਿ ਅਚੇਤ ਮੂੜ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਬਾਜੇ ਅਨਹਦ ਬਾਜਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: chet achet mooR man mere baaje anahad baajaa ||
lines.translation: Remember Him, O my thoughtless and foolish mind, and the unstruck melody of the sound current will resonate and resound.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ ਸੰਸਾ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਚੂਕੋ ਧ੍ਰੂ ਪ੍ਰਹਿਲਾਦ ਨਿਵਾਜਾ ॥੨॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: kahi kabeer sa(n)saa bhram chooko dhroo prahilaad nivaajaa ||2||5||
lines.translation: Says Kabeer, my skepticism and doubt have been dispelled; the Lord has exalted me, as He did Dhroo and Prahlaad. ||2||5||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: bilaaval ||
lines.translation: Bilaaval:

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਖਿ ਲੇਹੁ ਹਮ ਤੇ ਬਿਗਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: raakh lehu ham te bigaree ||
lines.translation: Save me! I have disobeyed You.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੀਲੁ ਧਰਮੁ ਜਪੁ ਭਗਤਿ ਨ ਕੀਨੀ ਹਉ ਅਭਿਮਾਨ ਟੇਢ ਪਗਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: seel dharam jap bhagat na keenee hau abhimaan tedh pagaree ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: I have not practiced humility, righteousness or devotional worship; I am proud and egotistical, and I have taken a crooked path. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਮਰ ਜਾਨਿ ਸੰਚੀ ਇਹ ਕਾਇਆ ਇਹ ਮਿਥਿਆ ਕਾਚੀ ਗਗਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: amar jaan sa(n)chee ih kaaiaa ih mithiaa kaachee gagaree ||
lines.translation: Believing this body to be immortal, I pampered it, but it is a fragile and perishable vessel.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਹਿ ਨਿਵਾਜਿ ਸਾਜਿ ਹਮ ਕੀਏ ਤਿਸਹਿ ਬਿਸਾਰਿ ਅਵਰ ਲਗਰੀ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: jinahi nivaaj saaj ham keee tisahi bisaar avar lagaree ||1||
lines.translation: Forgetting the Lord who formed, fashioned and embellished me, I have become attached to another. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੰਧਿਕ ਤੋਹਿ ਸਾਧ ਨਹੀ ਕਹੀਅਉ ਸਰਨਿ ਪਰੇ ਤੁਮਰੀ ਪਗਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: sa(n)dhik tohi saadh nahee kaheeau saran pare tumaree pagaree ||
lines.translation: I am Your thief; I cannot be called holy. I have fallen at Your feet, seeking Your Sanctuary.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ ਇਹ ਬਿਨਤੀ ਸੁਨੀਅਹੁ ਮਤ ਘਾਲਹੁ ਜਮ ਕੀ ਖਬਰੀ ॥੨॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: kahi kabeer ih binatee suneeahu mat ghaalahu jam kee khabaree ||2||6||
lines.translation: Says Kabeer, please listen to this prayer of mine, O Lord; please do not send me sommons of the Messenger of Death. ||2||6||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: bilaaval ||
lines.translation: Bilaaval:

lines.gurmukhi: ਦਰਮਾਦੇ ਠਾਢੇ ਦਰਬਾਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: daramaade thaadhe darabaar ||
lines.translation: I stand humbly at Your Court.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੁਝ ਬਿਨੁ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਕਰੈ ਕੋ ਮੇਰੀ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਦੀਜੈ ਖੋਲੑਿ ਕਿਵਾਰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: tujh bin surat karai ko meree darasan deejai kholhi kivaar ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Who else can take care of me, other than You? Please open Your door, and grant me the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੁਮ ਧਨ ਧਨੀ ਉਦਾਰ ਤਿਆਗੀ ਸ੍ਰਵਨਨੑ ਸੁਨੀਅਤੁ ਸੁਜਸੁ ਤੁਮੑਾਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: tum dhan dhanee udaar tiaagee sravananh suneeat sujas tumhaar ||
lines.translation: You are the richest of the rich, generous and unattached. With my ears, I listen to Your Praises.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਗਉ ਕਾਹਿ ਰੰਕ ਸਭ ਦੇਖਉ ਤੁਮੑ ਹੀ ਤੇ ਮੇਰੋ ਨਿਸਤਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: maagau kaahi ra(n)k sabh dekhau tumh hee te mero nisataar ||1||
lines.translation: From whom should I beg? I see that all are beggars. My salvation comes only from You. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੈਦੇਉ ਨਾਮਾ ਬਿਪ ਸੁਦਾਮਾ ਤਿਨ ਕਉ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਭਈ ਹੈ ਅਪਾਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: jaideu naamaa bip sudaamaa tin kau kripaa bhaee hai apaar ||
lines.translation: You blessed Jai Dayv, Naam Dayv and Sudaamaa the Brahmin with Your infinite mercy.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ ਤੁਮ ਸੰਮ੍ਰਥ ਦਾਤੇ ਚਾਰਿ ਪਦਾਰਥ ਦੇਤ ਨ ਬਾਰ ॥੨॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: kahi kabeer tum sa(n)mrath daate chaar padaarath det na baar ||2||7||
lines.translation: Says Kabeer, You are the All-powerful Lord, the Great Giver; in an instant, You bestow the four great blessings. ||2||7||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: bilaaval ||
lines.translation: Bilaaval:

lines.gurmukhi: ਡੰਡਾ ਮੁੰਦ੍ਰਾ ਖਿੰਥਾ ਆਧਾਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: da(n)daa mu(n)draa khi(n)thaa aadhaaree ||
lines.translation: He has a walking stick, ear-rings, a patched coat and a begging bowl.

lines.gurmukhi: ਭ੍ਰਮ ਕੈ ਭਾਇ ਭਵੈ ਭੇਖਧਾਰੀ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: bhram kai bhaai bhavai bhekhadhaaree ||1||
lines.translation: Wearing the robes of a beggar, he wanders around, deluded by doubt. ||1||
